name: player_keeptradecut_position_rank default branch reads the latest observation CARRYING the rank (executed-result parity)
description: The wide table's daily importer path writes value-only rows, so the latest observation for almost every player carries no rank at all -- measured on production 2026-07-31, 731 of the 742 players who have ever had a position rank. Under the old EAV shape the correlated MAX subquery carried its own `type` predicate, which made 'latest' mean 'latest row of THIS metric'. Removing the discriminator without replacing that predicate returns the latest row of any kind, and the rank reads NULL for ~98.5% of the population -- valid SQL, no error, an empty column. The fix is `IS NOT NULL` on the requested metric inside the correlated subquery. Seed a player whose newest observation is value-only and whose rank sits on the prior day; the correct answer is that prior day's rank, and reverting the predicate returns NULL.
